title: The Queen's Last Journey
subtitle: Elton Walk
welcome_text: [[c:A mystery walk around Elton's lanes, mill and church, starting and finishing at the Crown Inn. Follow the night in 1587 when a queen's coffin passed through the village.]]
start_text: [[c:Start at the Crown Inn on Duck Street, by the little green in the middle of the village.]]

route.name: Chapel Lane and the Elton Hall parkland
route.label: Chapel Lane

story: [[c:One night in July 1587, a slow procession of riders and torches came along Overend. On the cart lay the coffin of Mary, Queen of Scots, executed at Fotheringhay that February, on its way to Peterborough Cathedral.]]
[[c:The procession rested in Elton before crossing the river. By morning, a small silver casket that the Queen's servants had guarded all the way from Fotheringhay had vanished.]]

[[c:Four people were close to it that night: Ned Cobb, who kept the river crossing; Thomas Wade, the miller; Mistress Ellen Carey, one of the Queen's own servants; and Master Richard Hale, an officer of Queen Elizabeth's court.]]
[[c:Walk the village, solve the puzzles, gather the clues and work out who took the casket, and why.]]
